# An Overview of Cohere's Models

- The Command family of models includes [Command A+](command-a-plus), [Command A](command-a).
- [Parse](../../docs/parse) extracts structured, machine-readable data from unstructured enterprise documents, like forms and PDFs. It powers the [Parse](../../v2/reference/parse) endpoint.
- [Cohere Transcribe](../../v2/docs/transcribe) is Cohere's dedicated audio transcription model for automatic speech recognition (ASR). It powers the [Audio Transcriptions](../../v2/reference/create-audio-transcription) endpoint.
  [Cohere Transcribe Arabic](../../v2/docs/transcribe-arabic) is a version of the model optimized for Arabic-language audio.
- [North Mini Code](north-mini-code-1.0) for agentic coding.
